s.note: the first course in the first class dining saloon
s.how: Finely dice 2 shallots and mix with 80ml red wine vinegar and cracked pepper, then rest 20 minutes. Lay 24 freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice with lemon wedges and the mignonette.

s.note: the Irish dancing party below deck
s.how: Butter thick slices of a crusty loaf and fill with 300g ham and hot English mustard. Boil 600g small potatoes in their skins and toss with butter and salt. Serve together below deck.

m.note: dinner in first class with Rose's family
m.how: Layer 800g thinly sliced potatoes with 60g melted butter in a pan and bake at 200C for 50 minutes for pommes Anna. Tie 4 eye fillet steaks, sear in butter and roast to 54C. Reduce 2 shallots, 200ml red wine and 250ml stock for sauce. Serve with 300g green beans.

w.note: the dessert on the last first class menu
w.how: Cook 3 diced apples in 30g butter with 60g sultanas and tip into a dish. Whisk 3 eggs, 500ml milk and 60g sugar and pour over. Grate nutmeg on top and bake in a water bath at 160C for 40 minutes.

d.note: first class meets the party in steerage
d.how: Chill a 750ml bottle of sparkling wine and four 440ml cans of Irish stout. Half fill four tall flutes or glasses with stout, poured slowly so it settles. Top each slowly with sparkling wine poured over the back of a spoon so it sits on top. Serve straight away.
